name: task-list-viewer
title: Consumer task-list viewer
description: A consumer-defined task-list schema and controller over the shared text buffer, with a restylable borrowed React renderer.
docs: The installed task-list schema/controller are trusted consumer code; publication and draft recovery come from @hachej/boring-ui-kit/text-buffer. Construct a feature with a host-authenticated ResourceClient and exact source, then pass its concrete controller to TaskListViewer. Install native tools separately on the server. No host credentials or native kernel are copied into this item. Local tarball qualification only; no hosted release endpoint is advertised.
